info.desc: Lemonade is the sixth studio album by Beyoncé, released on April 23, 2016, accompanied by a 65-minute film of the same title on HBO, the Lemonade Film. It is Beyoncé's second "visual album", following her self-titled fifth studio album, and a concept album with a song cycle that relates Beyoncé's emotional journey after her husband's infidelity in a generational and racial context. Primarily an R&B and art pop album, Lemonade encompasses a variety of genres, including reggae, blues, rock, hip hop, soul, funk, Americana, country, gospel, electronic and trap. It features guest vocals from Jack White, The Weeknd, James Blake .

podcast.body: Beyoncé achieved enormous success with her album "Lemonade". The accompanying tour was exceptionally profitable, generating close to one million dollars per concert. This success positioned her as the second-highest earner in 2016, making her one of only two artists to surpass 100 million dollars that year. "la gira del Lemonade ha sido enormemente rentable generándole casi un millón de dólares por concierto."

podcast.body: This album was described as the "most acclaimed album of 2016" and lost Album of the Year to Adele's "25" in 2017, an outcome Adele herself apologized for from the stage. The defeat was cited as an example where avoiding repeat winners (like Adele) could have corrected a historical oversight. "the lemonade album was just so monumental, Beyonce. It was so monumental. And so well thought out, and so beautiful and so bearing."

podcast.body: This album was initially released under an exclusive contract with Apple Music, which Beyoncé later completely regretted. She has referenced this exclusive deal in her songs, indicating that it took a toll on her. "no tenemos el Lemony por un contrato exclusivo que hizo con Apple Music del que se acabó completamente repintiendo por el que yo estén en la exclusiva del Lemony, en el cual Villonz se en alguna canción ha dicho que la ha pasado factura"
